hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; [[ "$f" =~ \.(py|tsx|ts|js)$ ]] && [[ "$f" != *"CLAUDE.md"* ]] && [[ "$f" != *"ARCHITECTURE.md"* ]] && [[ "$f" != *"/docs/"* ]] && echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":"Doc protocol: this code file was just edited. Update the relevant CLAUDE.md / ARCHITECTURE.md / docs/ in the same commit — do not leave this for later."}}' || true; }
